doc: Phase 4.1 — setting-change tier registry. The Castle ECS Orchestrator and the Unity startup page both consume this file: it answers "if a user changes setting X, what level of restart is required?". Tier 0 = BB-write only (instant). Tier 1 = LiveKit reconnect (Brain process stays up; the next brain_entrypoint reads the new value). Tier 2 = Brain process restart (env/plugin/code change). Tier 3 = container/ECS restart (docker volume / system level).

0.label: BB-write
0.summary_en: Takes effect instantly; no restart required.

1.label: LiveKit reconnect
1.summary_en: Takes effect on the next LiveKit room job. Brain process stays up.
1.summary_zh: 需要 Unity 断线重连一次（Brain 进程不重启）
1.ux_decision_doc: Resolved 2026-05-12 (plan open-q-frontend-flow): Tier 1 defaults to explicit confirmation + auto-reconnect after the user accepts. Silent auto-reconnect was rejected because (a) Tier 1 transitions can change voice characteristics (LineA→LineB switches the pipeline / TTS / VAD), so the user must know a reconnect is happening; (b) the same reconnect path is used by the orchestrator from a Web monitor, where silent disconnects would surprise the on-device user. Toast copy: 'Switching pipelines — about to reconnect (~3s).'

2.label: Brain process restart
2.summary_en: Brain process must be restarted (~5-10s downtime).
2.summary_zh: 需要重启 Brain 进程（约 5-10 秒）

3.label: Container/ECS restart
3.summary_en: Container or full ECS restart required; not exposed to Unity UI.
3.summary_zh: 需要重启容器或整个 ECS，不暴露在 Unity 菜单
